lemmas.name: sorted_perm
lemmas.statement: ∀ (xs : List Int), List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) (xs.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))) ∧ List.isPerm xs (xs.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))) = true
lemmas.proof:
by intro xs
  exact ⟨List.pairwise_mergeSort' (· ≤ ·) xs, List.isPerm_iff.mpr (List.mergeSort_perm xs _).symm⟩
